title: Are you carrying some mixture of grief, anger, and fear and not sure what to do with it?

body:
Warm greetings, friends!

 Have you been sensing that something in our common life is coming apart?

 Wondering how to stay spiritually grounded when the “center” no longer seems to hold?

 Carrying some mixture of grief, anger, and fear, but not quite sure what to do with it?

 Consider spending a January weekend with a community of people who feel the same.

 Join Diana Butler Bass and me, along with a circle of thoughtful leaders and artists, as we explore:

 Wisdom From the Edge, When the Center Cannot Hold.

 Across the weekend of January 23-25, you’ll have space to:

 Listen and learn with others on a similar journey

 Practice simple spiritual rhythms you can actually use

 Find language for hard conversations

 Make room for a quieter, steadier hope in the year ahead

 If this sounds like where you are right now, Southern Lights may be just the place for you!

 We still have room for in-person attendees to join us in beautiful St. Simon’s Island, and plenty of space for virtual attendees, who will have access to the sessions both live and on-demand until April 30.

 You also have the option of giving the virtual session as a gift this Christmas – with a 20% discount.

 You’ll find all the information you need here: https://southernlightsconference.com/

 And you can register in-person or virtually here: https://www.eventbrite.com/e/southern-lights-conference-2026-registration-1138009349599
